summary: Stewart County tower listed as STT004 at 561 ft and marked removed; the list's name for it may be unofficial, and no build date or site description was found.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources. The Tennessee Landforms table gives the STT004 row as Fort Campbell, 561', Stewart, removed, with no district-tower number; the cached table is scrambled, so the row is read as one block. The name is the list's own label and the page says some names are unofficial; the record does not say whether this one is. Not the same tower as the standing Stewart County tower numbered 6-17 on the same list (650 ft, standing; a Waymarking listing calls it Model Tower or Barrow Tower; not used here). Waymarking was read through WebFetch, so it is not cited. The Army's 'Before Fort Campbell' history returned HTTP 403. Wikipedia's Fort Campbell article has no tower mention. No build date, staffing, fire or photo source found. The brief's 171.0 m matches 561 ft.
